description: Pins the connection rule in cli/schist/ingest.py (CONNECTION_RE, scan_connections, connection_body) and mcp-server/src/markdown-parser.ts (the same names in camelCase). `lines`: CONNECTION_RE on one line. `bodies`: the edges a body yields and the 0-based line of the first problem (null when there is none; a problem means no edges). `files`: whole note files, written to disk as UTF-8 bytes and read back the way each side reads notes (Python read_text, TS readNoteText); `body` is connection_body of the text, which ingest stores in docs.body for the viewer, and `edges` what ingest indexes. mcp-server/tests/connection-marked.test.ts also checks every body and file here against marked 12.0.2.
